class.name: ieir_controllers/GravityCompensationController
class.description: Gravity Compensation Controller using Pinocchio dynamics. Computes and applies gravity torques g(q) to compensate for gravitational effects.

class.name: ieir_controllers/JointImpedanceControllerPlugin
class.description: Joint Impedance Controller with Gravity Compensation using Pinocchio. Implements: tau = g(q) + Kp*(qd-q) + Kd*(vd-v) Supports per-joint gains and real-time target command updates.

class.name: ieir_controllers/JointPositionController
class.description: Joint-space position controller for DM motors in MIT mode. Forwards trajectory_msgs/JointTrajectory setpoints into the position/velocity/stiffness/damping command interfaces; the motor runs the inner PD loop. Designed to coexist with gravity_compensation_controller (which writes effort) -- the motor sums them into gravity-compensated joint impedance.

class.name: ieir_controllers/CartesianPositionControllerPlugin
class.description: Cartesian-space position controller for DM motors in MIT mode. Receives PoseStamped targets per arm, solves Pinocchio damped-LS IK, rate-limits the resulting joint trajectory, and forwards (pos, v_ff, kp, kd) into the MIT-mode command interfaces; the motor runs the inner PD loop. Designed to coexist with gravity_compensation_controller (which writes the effort interface).
